title: Red-Teaming for Generative AI: Silver Bullet or Security Theater?
reasoning: The paper focuses on the practice of red-teaming to ensure 'alignment with human and societal values.' It includes a dedicated discussion on the 'normative problem' of AI value alignment and critiques the non-universality of values used for evaluation (Section 4.3), which directly engages with ethical and moral frameworks in the context of LLM safety.
